title: Marcos, First Lady Liza take two days off to rest after 'whirlwind' of activities
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos took Sunday and Monday off to rest and recharge following weeks of hectic activities.

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos took Sunday and Monday off to rest and recharge following weeks of hectic activities.
In a Facebook post on Monday, Nov. 23, the First Lady shared a photo of herself with the President, saying they had decided to take a break after a “whirlwind of activities these past few weeks.”
“After a whirlwind of activities these past few weeks, we finally decided to take Sunday and Monday off to slow down, rest and recharge,” Liza said in the post.
The First Lady said they had no major plans and were simply enjoying some "peace and quiet" and much-needed downtime together.
“No big plans, no fuss ... just a little peace and quiet and some much-needed downtime together,” she said.
“And so far, we're loving it!” she added.
The Philippines hosted the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits in Manila from Nov. 16 to 18, with Marcos presiding over the meetings as the country's chair of the regional bloc.
The President then traveled to Shenzhen, China, to attend the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting on Nov. 19 and 20.—LDF, GMA News
